title: The Granary in the Clouds
story: The cloud-granary of Lofthollow floats above the valley, and Varrowkeen the Skimming Clerk has appointed himself its toll-taker. Each sack of sunwheat he sends down costs 8.5 gold crowns, plus a 20% "altitude surcharge" he invented this morning. Mr 6 must buy 40 sacks to feed the valley through the frost, and he has brought a purse of 450 crowns.
question: How many gold crowns will Mr 6 have left after paying for all 40 sacks with the surcharge?
solution: 40 sacks at 8.5 crowns each cost 8.5 * 40 = 340 crowns.
The 20% surcharge adds 340 * 0.20 = 68 crowns, so the total is 340 + 68 = 408 crowns.
praise: Multiplying out the sack price first was exactly right — the surcharge of 68 crowns just needed to be added before subtracting from the purse.
hint: Find the plain cost of 40 sacks first, then work out what 20% of that cost is.
victory: Mr 6 pays in full, then politely points out that a clerk who charges for altitude should refund for descent — Varrowkeen faints into a cloudbank and the sunwheat floats down free forever after.
imagePrompt: Mr 6, a cheerful numeral-six knight with helmet and blue cape, counts shining coins at a floating granary of woven cloud while a tall thin ink-stained clerk-monster with quill fingers clutches an enormous ledger, golden dawn light above a sea of clouds.
